# Bayesian Linear Regression

- [From least squares to a posterior](#from-least-squares-to-a-posterior)
- [Design matrices and normal geometry](#design-matrices-and-normal-geometry)

## From least squares to a posterior

- Normal linear models and coefficient priors
- Posterior coefficients, variance, and predictive distributions

Agresti 4.1–4.2

## Design matrices and normal geometry

- Categorical predictors, interactions, and collinearity
- Matrix formulation and multivariate normal updating

Agresti 4.3 and selected 4.6

# Model Criticism and Regularization

- [Model checking and predictive assessment](#model-checking-and-predictive-assessment)
- [Shrinkage and model complexity](#shrinkage-and-model-complexity)

## Model checking and predictive assessment

- Prior and posterior predictive checks; residual structure
- Cross-validation and the difference between fit and prediction

Agresti 4.4

## Shrinkage and model complexity

- Regularization as prior structure; bias–variance tradeoffs
- Compare weak and stronger priors without treating computation as validation

Agresti 4.5; Efron–Hastie reference

# Interpretation and Applications

- [What can the model support?](#what-can-the-model-support)
- [Planned Python demonstration](#planned-python-demonstration)

## What can the model support?

- Coefficient uncertainty versus uncertainty for a new response
- Association, interactions, and limits of causal claims

Agresti 4.2–4.4

## Planned Python demonstration

- Fit and check one regression model, then revise it
- Compare exact Gaussian calculations with a software fit

No companion notebook released yet
